links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Morning. Let's pick the flooring for the Level 4 fit-out today, plus the furniture delivery schedule.

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: I, um, I've been looking at it. I think we go with luxury vinyl plank, from Norvik Supply.

links.speaker: Aisha
links.quote: Why not carpet tile? Everyone's doing carpet tile.

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: Vinyl plank's about twenty percent cheaper than the carpet tile, it's quick to replace when a section gets damaged, and Norvik can deliver in three weeks.

links.speaker: Sven
links.quote: Norvik delivered the thing for the Level 2 floor on time, which I was surprised by, because their previous driver, you remember, he got lost twice, anyway-

links.speaker: Elif
links.quote: Is the twenty percent against the quote we have or, like, list?

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: Against the quote, I think. I can send it.

links.speaker: Aisha
links.quote: Playing devil's advocate, three weeks is only three weeks if nothing slips.

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: They've got stock.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Big picture, finance wants the floor signed off before the lease incentive ends. So three weeks matters more than anything. Mateo, you're sure about the stock?

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: They confirmed Tuesday.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Fine by me. Mateo, lock in the delivery slot.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Furniture schedule. Sven?

links.speaker: Sven
links.quote: Furniture's booked for the fourteenth, but I got a call that the crew might be, hm, a day late, because of the other site-

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: How late?

links.speaker: Sven
links.quote: One day. Maybe two.

links.speaker: Elif
links.quote: Two would hurt, I think? Because of the move-in date.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Which move-in date?

links.speaker: Elif
links.quote: The nineteenth. Staff start arriving then. I think.

links.speaker: Aisha
links.quote: It is. I checked it with HR yesterday.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Then we can't slip past the eighteenth. Sven, push them.

links.speaker: Sven
links.quote: I'll push. Yes.

links.speaker: Aisha
links.quote: Also, who's got the sample planks?

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: Norvik is sending three boxes.

links.speaker: Aisha
links.quote: Good, I can test them.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Test what?

links.speaker: Aisha
links.quote: Whatever. Spills, mopping. I like to break stuff.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Fine, but don't delay anything for it.

links.speaker: Aisha
links.quote: I won't.

links.speaker: Elif
links.quote: Is anyone doing the, um, budget revisions?

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Me, Friday.

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: I can help.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Thanks. Okay, that's it.

links.speaker: Sven
links.quote: One more thing, there's a, a coffee machine thing-

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Email me.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Right. I don't want to decide this in the meeting.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Right. I don't want to decide this in the meeting.

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: Should I hold the order?

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Hold the order, yes.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Something else. Furniture. Sven?

links.speaker: Aisha
links.quote: They came Thursday. So I did a mock-up of the pantry floor, laid planks with the seams as delivered, and had the cleaners mop it wet the way they do every night.

links.speaker: Aisha
links.quote: Honestly, if it's just a nightly mop, it's a worst case. But a dishwasher leaks, or it rains for a week and everyone tracks it in, then yes.

links.speaker: Sven
links.quote: Our pantry has a sink that's been leaking since the survey. I'm just saying.

links.speaker: Elif
links.quote: I think this is a real problem. The pantry and the entrance, that's where the spills and the wet shoes are, every single day.

links.speaker: Elif
links.quote: If seams are open there, I think the planks will lift, and from what I read the warranty won't cover moisture damage on unsealed seams in wet areas.

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: Oh. That's, hm.

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: I didn't notice that.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Right. The flooring question again. With the mock-up result and what Elif found in the warranty, I think we need to look at this again before we order anything.

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: I called Norvik. They said they can heat-weld the seams at the factory, it's a thing they do.

links.speaker: Sven
links.quote: So, listen, we keep the vinyl plank, because it's cheaper and the delivery is fine, but we get the seams heat-sealed, and across the pantry and the entrance, the first stretch, we put ceramic tile instead of plank.

links.speaker: Aisha
links.quote: How wide a stretch is enough?

links.speaker: Sven
links.quote: Elif, you said the wet area was a few meters.

links.speaker: Elif
links.quote: Pantry is about four meters, the entrance maybe two. A tile band across both gives margin.

links.speaker: Aisha
links.quote: And the tile band, that's what, extra cost?

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: Small. I priced it, a few thousand.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Versus tile everywhere?

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: Way less. I think about a third of the difference.

links.speaker: Aisha
links.quote: Devil's advocate, who seals the seams where we cut planks on site?

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: Norvik pre-cuts to our drawings. We'd have almost no field cuts.

links.speaker: Elif
links.quote: And the ones we do have, I'd want a seam sealer on them. The warranty mentions it.

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Okay. I'm fine with that. So, we're keeping the Norvik vinyl plank, with heat-sealed seams and a ceramic tile band across the pantry and the entrance.

links.speaker: Mateo
links.quote: Placing the order today?

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Yes. Place it.

links.speaker: Aisha
links.quote: Sample planks, do I keep testing them?

links.speaker: Tariq
links.quote: Sealed seams, yes, test those. That's useful.
